limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 126 of 129 deposited .raw files annotated. Excluded: the 3 SILAC RUNX1 immunoprecipitation runs 20190719_MaS_KB_OE_Runx1_R1.raw, 20190719_MaS_KB_OE_Runx1_R2.raw, 20190514_MaS_RUNX1_IP_02.raw (MaxQuant RUNX1_OE, multiplicity 3: light / Arg6;Lys4 / Arg10;Lys8). Their channel map is contradictory across sources: (1) paper and PRIDE protocol prose list pCMV_Flag_RUNX1, pCMV_Flag_RUNX1_S276L, empty pCMV_Flag then ("light":"medium":"heavy"); (2) supplemental Table S3.1 states Flag empty = Light in BR1-3, RUNX1_S276L = Medium/Heavy/Medium and RUNX1_wt = Heavy/Medium/Heavy for BR1/BR2/BR3; (3) deposited data: RUNX1 is lowest in light (supports Table S3.1 over the prose for the empty-vector channel), but the only S276L-specific peptide (QIQPSPPWSYDQSYQYLGSIASPSVHPATPILPGR) is quantified in the MEDIUM channel of IP_RUNX1_02 = Table BR2 (S3.1 says S276L = Heavy there; weak ID: score 39.3, PEP 0.043, H/M 0.62), the HDAC1 BR1 ratios and the authors' own averaged wt_emp column both fit the inverse M/H assignment. In addition the third deposited run (20190514_MaS_RUNX1_IP_02, 5% MS/MS identified) shares only 232 peptides with the BR3 data of Table S3.2 (1848 peptides), so Table BR3 most likely comes from an undeposited run. Per batch rules 6/7 the arm is left out rather than annotated with a contradicted or unresolved channel identity. Section in annotations/BLOCKED.md.

Phospho runs F1-F10 are sequential TiO2 enrichment rounds per the Methods; the supplementary workflow legend says high-pH fractions were "measured directly (proteome) or applied to phosphopeptide enrichment", which could mean the phospho samples were also hpH fractions. MaxQuant gives all 10 phospho files of a replicate one fraction number, consistent with enrichment rounds; comment[fractionation method] is not applicable on phospho rows.

Whether the three pulldown replicates (and three inputs) come from independent cultures or one lysate is not stated ("three independent pulldowns", 2 mg pre-cleared input each); they are numbered biological replicates 1-3 per bait group.
Collision energy for the pulldown runs (27 NCE) is read from the embedded instrument method of 4 of the 12 files (all four identical); not stated in the paper.
A375 R has no Cellosaurus entry; the parental CVCL_0132 is used (precedent PXD010683). Passage number, storage temperature, cell type and individual are not available.
techsdrf is not installed; instrument and NCE were verified by HTTP range reads of the raw headers instead.

sdrf-tools reconcile reports two findings (SILAC quantification method, Q Exactive HF-X in the protocol); both concern only the excluded SILAC IP runs - refuted with evidence in PXD018305.validation.txt.
